text: Please, please and once again please, can you add gifting weapons to your friends. But exept that i looove this app, thanks
author: Andrija Podobnik
developer_reply: Andrija, thanks for your review and feedback! We now have an official suggestion and comment form to help us keep track of what features users want the most. You can find it via Menu - About - Send Feedback if you’d like to add your ideas.

text: Amazing app! Turning habits into a game keeps me motivated and consistent. Highly recommend!
author: DG
developer_reply: Thanks so much for your review. We're happy to hear Habitica has been motivating for you! If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback. Happy adventuring, Taryn!

author: Petar Frane Basa
developer_reply: Thanks so much for your review, Petar. We're happy to hear how much you like Habitica! If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback.

text: I don't want an app to need constant internet connection, especially since this app is about personal goals. Getting server connection error even when i do have internet made me uninstall.
author: Cyanity
developer_reply: Most users are reporting that the mobile apps are now working as expected. The app may need a hard close/restart. Please let us know if you experience any further trouble via admin@habitica.com and we'll investigate. Thank you so much for your patience as we worked to resolve this!

text: Unnecessary permissions and intrusive account creation.
author: Ivan Zanki
developer_reply: Hi, Ivan! Thanks for giving Habitica a try! An account is necessary so that your tasks and progress can sync across all platforms and devices (web, phone, tablet, etc.). Sorry that's not what you were looking for.
